final_classification.name: fixed_hybrid_guarded_lower_bound
final_classification.summary: The body performs a lower-bound-shaped tree walk, then accepts the retained candidate only when the query is not less than the candidate key. With the traversal invariant candidate.key >= query, the accepted candidate is equal to the query. This is not caller-specific and it is not conventional lower_bound.
not_a: A conventional lower_bound or ceiling iterator
A robust exact-find guarantee for every valid tree shape

source_contract: void __thiscall lookup(OrderedMap* map, OrderedMapEntry** out, const uint32_t* key): initialize candidate to &map->anchor and node to map->anchor.parent; while node is non-null, move left when node->key < *key, otherwise retain node and move right; write the retained node to *out only when *key >= candidate->key, otherwise write &map->anchor.

result_matrix.result: end sentinel because the least-greater successor is rejected

instruction_evidence.fact: MOV EAX,[ECX+0x0c] loads the root from anchor.parent.
LEA EDX,[ECX+0x04] forms the map anchor/end sentinel.
MOV ECX,EDX initializes the retained candidate to the end sentinel.
CMP [EAX+0x10],ESI followed by JC takes the unsigned left branch when node.key < query; otherwise the node becomes the candidate and the right branch is taken.
The walk terminates only when the next child is null.
The sentinel candidate is rejected before reading candidate.key.
CMP EAX,[ECX+0x10] followed by JC rejects the candidate when query < candidate.key; there is no equality branch or equality instruction.
The retained candidate is written through the result pointer only on the accepted path.
The end sentinel is written through the result pointer on the rejected path.

caller_evidence.observation: The noun consumer checks only whether the returned node is the map end at this+0x9c. The end branch creates and inserts; every non-end node is consumed at +0x14 without a key-equality test.
caller_evidence.reason: A successor return would incorrectly select a greater noun record instead of entering creation. It is not lower-bound dependent because no caller-side equality or range interpretation permits a greater key.

caller_evidence.observation: The empire-map wrapper rejects this+0x154 and then dereferences node+0x14 without checking node+0x10 against the requested political ID.
caller_evidence.reason: A returned successor would be returned as though it were the requested empire.

caller_evidence.observation: The body is only MOV EAX,[0x0167eae0]; RET at 0x00b3d300-0x00b3d305.
caller_evidence.reason: It neither calls nor consumes the map-search result. Its existing root-publication and lifetime gate remains separate.

caller_evidence.observation: The current-empire cache calls 0x00ba9370 and stores the returned object without checking its +0x84 political ID. The +0x84 check at 0x01021315 applies only to the previously cached object.
caller_evidence.reason: A successor returned by 0x00ba9370 would be cached as the current empire. It is not lower-bound dependent and the helper result is not an iterator.
